module: Flowgraph node "on Update" (category logic, event). Emits flow every frame. Output pins: enterState (pulse on entering the project state), flow (every frame), exitState (pulse on leaving the state), dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw (delta times, hidden). Also updates mgr.dtReal/dtSim/dtRaw.
notes: On state events (start and end) the three delta times are reset to 0.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: sets flow to true, copies the delta times to mgr and the pins, triggers the node.

onStateStartedTrigger.desc: Called when the project enters the state: enterState true, delta times at 0.

onStateStoppedTrigger.desc: Called when the project leaves the state: exitState true, delta times at 0.
